details.description: Men’s skin and hair go through a lot. Daily hustle, pollution, dirt, and sweat strip off the skin’s moisture and make it look dull. Axe 3 in 1 Body, Face & Hair Wash for Men is specially formulated to restore the skin’s & hair’s health while improving the overall appearance. Axe Africa all-in-one shower gel for men helps eliminate all those extra steps from your daily shower routine, saving you time. Made with 100% plant-based prebiotics and 87% natural ingredients, it helps skin retain its natural moisture level. Furthermore, it is enriched with added moisture to double the nourishment so that your skin feels even smoother and softer after every shower. While nourishing & hydrating the skin, this gentle Body, Hair & Face Cleanser also effectively removes dirt, impurities, odour, and bacteria to keep you refreshed for long. Axe Body Wash comes with a unique formula for a long-lasting fragrance that stays for up to 12 hours. With Axe Body Wash’s squeezed mandarin & sandalwood scent, get indulged in an enlivening bathing experience and keep smelling magnetic all day. From day to night, Axe Fragrant Body Wash is your way to be always AXE READY! Dermatologically tested and made with no parabens, it gives a true Axe Effect.
details.usageInstructions: Pour this fragrant shower gel on the palm of your hand or a bath sponge. Gently massage all over your body & hair and work into a lather. Enjoy the tempting scent while massaging for a few minutes, and then rinse thoroughly with water.
